summary: Payette NF ground lookout in Adams County: tent camp 1909, house burned 1923 per newspaper, cab 1933, gone by 1966 when disposed of by burning.

facts.status_note: Lookout house disposed of by burning in 1966 per Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts also date its loss to 1966. A 2019 photo caption refers to 'what remains' without describing it.

staffing.status: known staff listed for 1942: Leonard Williams

access.note: On Payette National Forest land. No source says the site is closed or restricted, and none describes the site now. The level is an inference from the land status.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site hike-in. The climbing page describes the peak as roadless with primitive trails; no source gives a route to the lookout site.

events.note: Tent camp lookout established, per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts.
Lookout house burned to the ground on the night of July 17, per a July 22, 1923 newspaper report quoted by Forest Lookouts. Cause not determined.
Forest Lookouts dates a new ground cabin to 1923 to 1924. The other two pages date a log cabin to 1924.
R-4 cab per firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts; Idaho Fire Lookouts calls it an L-4 cab, 1 mile northwest.
Leonard Williams listed as known lookout staff.
Coast and Geodetic Survey 1959 station description calls the lookout house abandoned; peakbagging.com caption says abandoned by 1959.
Forest Lookouts: structure disposed of by burning. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say gone in 1966.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date the 1933 cab as an R-4; Idaho Fire Lookouts calls it an L-4 cab. The story gives both and does not choose.

Forest Lookouts quotes a July 1923 newspaper report that the lookout house burned on the night of July 17 and dates a replacement ground cabin to 1923-24. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date a log cabin to 1924. The story reports both sequences.

notes_for_editor: The 1933 cab type conflicts: R-4 in firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts, L-4 in Idaho Fire Lookouts. Forest Lookouts' 1923 fire and replacement cabin differ from the 1924 log cabin date on the other two pages; the story reports both. Coordinates in the record (FFLA 44.7203, -116.28038) and Idaho Fire Lookouts' coordinates (44.71072, -116.2693) are about 1.4 km apart. The peakbagging caption puts the lookout about 0.8 miles north of the USGS Council benchmark, so check the pin on a map before use. Access level 'public' is inferred from national forest land, not stated in a source. No corrections to the brief's record; the record had no events and no staffing.
